purpose: Provide a playful asymmetric eye option with a soft tilted teardrop silhouette.

arguments.prompt:

Asset type: transparent cartoon game sprite variation for SLEVEJM3.BMP-004
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the shark body, waves, yellow mermaid hair, palette, linework, placement, framing, and transparent canvas. Images 2 and 3 are the exact original low-resolution frame and enlarged nearest-neighbor reference; use them only as authority for the playful asymmetric eye language.
Primary request: Change only the shark's single visible lower/right eye in Image 1. Make it a soft tilted teardrop-shaped white eye: broadly open and playful, with a rounded outer/front end and one gently tapered inner/rear corner, clearly not a perfect circle or upright oval. Add one round black pupil looking forward/right toward the yellow hair, with a small friendly catchlight. The expression must read curious, excited, and playful.
Constraints: Retain exactly one visible eye in the same lower/right facial location. Keep the upper gray forehead completely clean, with no second eye, no stray dark mark, and no eyebrow. Preserve every other pixel-level design decision from Image 1 as closely as possible: identical shark silhouette, dorsal fin, highlights, gray shading, snout, body pose, water waves, cyan outlines, yellow hair, black outlines, cropping, scale, and genuinely transparent background. No mouth or teeth changes. No new objects, text, or watermark.
Avoid: perfect-circle eye; tall upright oval; narrow slit; hostile, dangerous, angry, devious, sleepy, or predatory expression; brow; eyelashes; second facial mark; body restyling.
